# Church Job Board — llms.txt

## About
A job board for churches and ministries in Kansas City, Missouri, and Kansas. 20 real openings, each link-verified live at launch: pastors, worship leaders, children's and youth ministry, operations, and production roles. Every listing links to the employer's real application page.

## Post a job
- Standard listing, $99 for 30 days: https://buy.stripe.com/4gM4gAe7Aeg7foO62w0gw0A
- Featured listing, $199 for 30 days: https://buy.stripe.com/8x2eVe9Rkfkba4u1Mg0gw0B
- Post a job: https://c2r-marketing.github.io/church-jobs/post-a-job/
- Listings go live after payment.

## Job alerts
Free email alerts for new church jobs: https://c2r-marketing.github.io/church-jobs/ (signup on every page).
